require 'rss'
require 'time'

# Fetch and parse RSS feed from the provided URL
url = kwargs[:url] || args.first
raise ArgumentError, "URL is required" if url.nil? || url.empty?

uri = URI.parse(url)
fetched_at = Time.now.utc.iso8601

begin
  # Fetch the RSS feed
  response = Net::HTTP.get_response(uri)
  
  unless response.is_a?(Net::HTTPSuccess)
    result = Agent::Outcome.error(
      error_type: "http_fetch_failed",
      error_message: "Failed to fetch feed: HTTP #{response.code}",
      retriable: true,
      tool_role: @role,
      method_name: "fetch_feed"
    )
    return result
  end
  
  # Parse RSS
  feed = RSS::Parser.parse(response.body, false)
  
  unless feed
    result = Agent::Outcome.error(
      error_type: "rss_parse_failed",
      error_message: "Failed to parse RSS feed from #{url}",
      retriable: false,
      tool_role: @role,
      method_name: "fetch_feed"
    )
    return result
  end

      title: item.title.to_s.strip,
      link: item.link.to_s.strip,

          retrieval_tool: @role,
          retrieval_mode: "live"

    }

    tool_role: @role,
    method_name: "fetch_feed"
  )
end

    error_message: "Search query is required",
    retriable: false,
    tool_role: @role,
    method_name: "ok?"
  )
else
  begin
    # Use DuckDuckGo Instant Answer API (simple, no auth required)
    encoded_query = CGI.escape(query.to_s)
    search_uri = URI("https://api.duckduckgo.com/?q=#{encoded_query}&format=json&no_html=1&skip_disambig=1")
    
    http = Net::HTTP.new(search_uri.host, search_uri.port)
    http.use_ssl = true
    http.open_timeout = 10
    http.read_timeout = 10
    
    request = Net::HTTP::Get.new(search_uri)
    request['User-Agent'] = 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; WebSearcher/1.0)'
    
    response = http.request(request)
    fetched_at = Time.now.utc.iso8601
    
    # Handle all non-200 responses as errors
    unless response.code.to_i == 200
      result = Agent::Outcome.error(
        error_type: "network_failure",
        error_message: "HTTP #{response.code} from search provider",
        retriable: (response.code.to_i >= 500),
        tool_role: @role,
        method_name: "ok?"
      )
    else
      data = JSON.parse(response.body)
      
      results = []
      
      # Extract Abstract if available
      if data["Abstract"] && !data["Abstract"].empty?
        results << {
          title: data["Heading"] || query,
          snippet: data["Abstract"],
          url: data["AbstractURL"] || ""
        }
      end
      
      # Extract RelatedTopics
      if data["RelatedTopics"].is_a?(Array)
        data["RelatedTopics"].each do |topic|
          if topic.is_a?(Hash) && topic["Text"] && topic["FirstURL"]
            results << {
              title: topic["Text"].split(" - ").first || topic["Text"],
              snippet: topic["Text"],
              url: topic["FirstURL"]
            }
          end
        end
      end
      
      # Check acceptance criteria: non-empty results
      if results.empty?
        result = Agent::Outcome.error(
          error_type: "low_utility",
          error_message: "Search returned no relevant results for query: #{query}",
          retriable: false,
          tool_role: @role,
          method_name: "ok?"
        )
      else
        result = Agent::Outcome.ok(
          value: {
            results: results,
            query: query,
            provenance: {
              sources: [
                {
                  uri: search_uri.to_s,
                  fetched_at: fetched_at,
                  retrieval_tool: @role,
                  retrieval_mode: "live"
                }
              ]
            }
          }
        )
      end
    end
    
  rescue StandardError => e
    result = Agent::Outcome.error(
      error_type: "network_failure",
      error_message: "Search failed: #{e.class.name} - #{e.message}",
      retriable: true,
      tool_role: @role,
      method_name: "ok?"
    )
  end
end
